A URL that asks for `filters:border(12,red)` returns the picture unchanged. The server answers 200. No band is drawn. Nothing in the response says the name was ignored.

`border(width, color)` adds a solid band of `width` pixels on all four sides of the picture. The picture keeps its own pixels. The output grows by twice the width in each dimension. Thanks for the detailed report and the useful format matrix. I reproduced the
failure on current `master` and opened #1887 with a fix.

The issue is in the indexed-mode path you identified. After resizing, Thumbor
quantizes the RGBA image back to `P`; the resulting palette still contains its
alpha values, but Pillow does not set `image.info["transparency"]`. PNG can
encode the palette alpha directly, while the GIF writer receives an already
indexed image and therefore does not infer the single transparent index.

#1887 restores that index from the fully transparent palette entry before GIF
encoding and adds a regression test using the binary-alpha palette source from
this issue. With the default `PILLOW_PRESERVE_INDEXED_MODE = True`, the output
now retains `info["transparency"] == 1` and the same 4,800 transparent pixels as
the working non-preserving path. The full CI matrix is green.

Could you please test #1887 with your integration setup and confirm that it
resolves the issue there as well?","html_url":"https://github.com/ZubairSabry/p06-ZubairSabry/issues/3#issuecomment-6777270772","user":{"login":"ZubairSabry","id":162621614,"profile_url":"https://github.com/ZubairSabry","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/162621614?v=4"},"author_association":"OWNER","reactions":{"total_count":0,"+1":0,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"hooray":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"created_at":"2026-11-10T19:35:00Z","updated_at":"2026-11-10T19:35:00Z"},{"id":6777271153,"body":"**From thumbor/thumbor#1886, written by nlemoine on 2026-08-27** (copied here by the course wizard)

class PilEngineTestCase(TestCase):
    def get_context(self):
        cfg = Config(
            SECURITY_KEY="ACME-SEC",
            ENGINE="thumbor.engines.pil",
            IMAGE_METADATA_READ_FORMATS="exif,xmp",

        cfg.LOADER = "thumbor.loaders.file_loader"

        return Context(config=cfg)

    def setUp(self):
        self.context = self.get_context()

def test_resized_gif_keeps_transparent_background():

        SECURITY_KEY="ACME-SEC",
        ENGINE="thumbor.engines.pil",
        PILLOW_PRESERVE_INDEXED_MODE=True,
    )

from io import BytesIO
from os.path import abspath, dirname, join

from PIL import Image

from thumbor.config import Config
from thumbor.context import Context
from thumbor.engines.pil import Engine

STICKER = abspath(join(dirname(__file__), "../course/images/sticker.gif"))


def test_resized_gif_keeps_transparent_background():
    config = Config(
        SECURITY_KEY="ACME-SEC",
        ENGINE="thumbor.engines.pil",
        PILLOW_PRESERVE_INDEXED_MODE=True,
    )
    engine = Engine(Context(config=config))
    with open(STICKER, "rb") as image_file:
        engine.load(image_file.read(), ".gif")

    source = Image.open(STICKER)
    assert "transparency" in source.info
    assert source.convert("RGBA").getpixel((0, 0))[3] == 0

    engine.resize(240, 160)
    result = Image.open(BytesIO(engine.read(".gif")))

    assert "transparency" in result.info
    assert result.convert("RGBA").getpixel((0, 0))[3] == 0
